message: Darius, hi—I’d like to offer you a job creating a UGC video for me.
Sure, I’m interested! Please send me the details.
The video needs to be in Arabic MSA.
You’ll find all the project information in this shared folder: <https://files.cedarvault.example/drive/folders/folder-4827?usp=drive_link>
My offer is 120$ for this video.
Since Elina contacted me about the same application, are you working with her?
Since you don’t have the Arabic script, I also have to translate it; that’s why Elina and I agreed on 180.
We can set it at 180$; that’s no problem.
yeah :)
Would it be okay if I opened a contract for you?
Go ahead with the contract, and please send the script so I can translate it; that will take roughly 45 minutes.
script here
Before I open a contract for you, please review the script and let me know whether I can proceed.
I already have the script and it looks good, so you can proceed with the contract.
I’ve accepted the contract. When I finish the video, should I upload it to google drive?
yes please :)
Hello—the link you sent isn’t working for me :(
Since the previous link isn’t usable, please either send the video directly in this chat or post a working link here.
oh weird
I'll handle it within 12 seconds.
For the replacement delivery, here is the video link: <https://files.cedarvault.example/file/d/document-7314/view?usp=sharing>
The link is functional and viewable by anyone who has it!
Confirm please
Thanks—I'll review and respond within 3 days.

1\. Begin by acting as though you’re reading the question from your phone
2\. At the appropriate moments, tap the screen a little more confidently
3\. Follow the script a little more closely, and the video can run for 2 minutes
4\. For the overall setting, please film in a homey atmosphere with a room interior in the background
Aside from those changes, I really like it overall—she’s charismatic)
Seated on the couch is how I’ll film it :) I’ll send it in four or five days.
thanks! waiting!
The version I sent is 75 seconds long; what exact duration would you like?
Should it run exactly 3 minutes?
Keep the revised video below 3 minutes.
Hello! Could you send the video directly here in the chat, please?
The revised video is available here in the chat: <https://files.cedarvault.example/file/d/document-9652/view?usp=sharing>
This time, the video didn’t follow the script...
Please reshoot the video and say every scripted phrase strictly as written.

First, I followed the phrases strictly in all four videos—not just the latest one, but the previous ones as well. They were exactly what you asked for and even better than the sample video you sent.

Also, without a translated script, how can you be so certain about the phrases when you had me translate it?

I won’t do another reshoot because all four are great. If you don’t like them, tell me and pay at least 75% of the amount. I’m reporting this to Upwork.
